name: DSW Beauty Calls, 3 July 2003

date.source: The broadcast's own dateline; posted in three parts, 3-4 July 2003.

appearances.source: Backstage interview segments throughout the broadcast.

matches.note: Ophelia Johnson won by pinfall (Le Petit Mort) in 6:37, her first win in the promotion, per the show's own commentary and the promotion's own results bulletin.
Tara Marshall won by pinfall (Total Eclipse) in 8:31, per the promotion's own results bulletin.

notes: Posted in three parts on 3-4 July 2003; served here as one continuous broadcast. A closing vignette introduces an unnamed newcomer arriving in Carson City; her identity is not revealed in the held record.
